standard_prerequisites.name: The alternating Cech complex of a complex of modules is the total complex of the double complex of alternating Cech groups, with conventions recorded in the cohomology Cech section
standard_prerequisites.use: Fixes the right-hand double complex F and its differentials.

standard_prerequisites.name: The maps psi from the Hom colimit double complex to the Cech double complex constructed in the single-complex alternating lemma are termwise isomorphisms compatible with the first differential
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces the comparison of the two double complexes to a sign fix.

standard_prerequisites.name: The hom complex of complexes of modules carries its own differential convention, recorded in the More on Algebra hom-complex section
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the left-hand differential whose sign differs from the total complex convention.

core_obligations: Set up the double complex F with terms F^{p,q} = C^p_alt(U, F^q) and the double complex G with terms G^{p,q} = colim_e Hom_A(I^{-p}(f_1^e, ..., f_r^e), M^q), the latter with differentials from functoriality (proof lines 2246-2256).
The maps psi^{p,q} from the proof of the single-complex alternating lemma are termwise isomorphisms compatible with d_1 by that lemma and with d_2 evidently (proof lines 2257-2260).

Fix the signs: the hom-complex differential on G is d_2 - (-1)^{p+q} d_1 while the total complex differential on F is d_1 + (-1)^p d_2; multiplying psi^{p,q} by (-1)^{pq + p(p-1)/2} makes the maps compatible with the full differentials, giving the canonical isomorphism of total complexes (proof lines 2261-2268).
proof_roadmap: Build the two double complexes from Cech terms and Hom colimits (proof lines 2246-2256).
Check the termwise isomorphisms against both differentials (proof lines 2257-2260).
Correct the sign difference between the two differential conventions (proof lines 2261-2268).
